OZUK · DRAFT FOR REVIEW

Privacy Policy

Your information deserves care and clarity.

This is draft content. It must be reviewed and updated to reflect Ozuk’s actual practices before the app launches.

01

About this policy

Ozuk brings together insights about sleep, activity, stress, and readiness. The final policy will explain how information is handled across the website, app, and connected ring services.

02

Information we may handle

Depending on the features you use, information may include account details, ring measurements, app interactions, and technical device information. The final policy will identify which information is collected and when.

03

How information may be used

Information may be used to provide personal insights, connect your ring, support your account, and improve reliability. The final version will describe the purposes for each type of information and any relevant choices.

04

Storage and sharing

Details about service providers, storage locations, retention periods, and safeguards will be added after they are confirmed. The final policy will explain when information is shared and for what purpose.

05

Your choices

Device permissions can affect which features are available. The final policy will describe how to manage permissions and request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information.

06

Contact and updates

Official company details and a privacy contact will be added here before launch. This page will be updated as the policy is finalized, with a clear effective date.
